data.long_meaning: Charishmaa is derived from the Sanskrit word 'charish' meaning 'radiant' and 'maa' meaning 'mother'. This beautiful name symbolizes the inner radiance and nurturing spirit of a mother. The name Charishmaa carries the meaning “Radiant Beauty” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Charishmaa usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charishmaa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Charishmaa is mentioned in the Mahabharata as the name of a beautiful and virtuous lady who was a descendant of King Bharata and the wife of Sahadeva, one of the five Pandava brothers. She was known for her grace, beauty, and her ability to calm anger.

Another mention of Charishmaa can be found in the Puranas, where she is described as one of the 64 Yogini goddesses. These goddesses were believed to represent various aspects of the divine feminine and were invoked during tantric rituals for various purposes.
